Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players stride out to the middle. Sophie Devine is not on the field and Amy Satterthwaite will be the stand-in captain. Tammy Beaumont and Danni Wyatt will open the batting for England Women. Jess Kerr will begin with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! England Women need to chase down a target of 204 runs, to win their second game of this tournament and grab two vital points. New Zealand Women do face a tough task but certainly not an impossible one. Can they defend this total? We will find out!

Kate Cross is down for a chat. She says that she enjoyed bowling in the wind and got the key wickets of Bates and Devine. Mentions that they wanted to improve their fielding after the first three games and they have done well in that department in this game. States that they have a strong batting line-up and they will look to chase this down.

England Women did not start well with the ball, but they fought back well and grabbed wickets at regular intervals. They made sure no batters go on and make a big score. They did not let any batters settle in and whenever New Zealand Women were trying to build a partnership, the bowlers stepped up and grabbed wickets. Kate Cross and Sophie Ecclestone grabbed 3 wickets each, while Charlotte Dean was impressive as well, she picked up 2 wickets and gave away just 36 runs in her spell. England Women do have a golden chance here to get their second win since the conditions are also favoring the batters.

New Zealand Women started the innings on a positive note and displayed their aggression straightaway. They were 52 for 0 in the first 10 overs. Suzie Bates was the first one to depart and Sophie Devine was sent back to the hut after being injured. Amelia Kerr and Amy Satterthwaite did try to rebuild and tried to steady the ship, but they failed to go on and perished in trying to up the ante. Wickets started to tumble from thereafter. If not for Maddy Green's half-century, New Zealand Women would not have been able to cross the 200-run mark. A tough task ahead for the bowlers and they need to put their best foot forward now.

End of an exceptional bowling performance! England Women picked up from where they left off in the last game. They put up a fine bowling performance against India Women in their previous game, and they have done the same here. All the bowlers justified their skipper's decision of bowling first and have bundled out the hosts for a below-par score. New Zealand Women will be disappointed with the score they have put up after getting off to a good start. They do face an uphill task ahead, as it is not going to be easy defending 204 on this batting-friendly wicket.

OUT! RUN OUT! Complete miscommunication and that ends New Zealand's innings. This was a length ball, on middle. Kerr nudges it through square leg and she looks to come back for the second run. Green though is not sure as at first, she calls for the second but denies it in the end. Kerr is halfway down the pitch when the throw comes in from the deep by Charlotte Dean at the bowler's end. Brunt collects the ball cleanly and whips the bails off. New Zealand Women are bowled out for 203!
FOUR! Clever from Kerr! Full and too wide, outside off. Kerr reaches out and slices it past point for yet another boundary. 200 comes up for New Zealand Women!

Back of a length, on midde. Jess Kerr pulls it uppishly towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! WHACKED! Short and wide, outside off. Kerr stands tall and caresses it through cover to bag a boundary.

On a length, around off. Kep out.
A short ball, on middle. Jess Kerr pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one run.
FIFTY for Green! What an innings this has been from here! Good-length ball, around off. Green defends it to point and takes a single.
A length ball, jagging back in from middle. Green misses her whip on the leg side and gets hit on her pad.
On off. Green taps it to point for a run.
Natalie Sciver (8-1-23-0) is brought back into the attack.
Flatter ball, on a length, around off. Maddy Green defends it to the off side.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Just when a partnership was building, England Women have struck! They have done this throughout the innings, picked up wickets at crucial times. Sophie Ecclestone gets her third wicket now, and New Zealand Women lose their ninth wicket. Sophie Ecclestone serves am arm ball, outside off, quicker as well. Hannah Rowe stays in her crease and tries to guide this towards third man, but she manages to get a faint edge back to the Amy Jones behind the stumps who takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Amy Jones b Sophie Ecclestone

Review! England Women think that it hit the pad first and they opt for a review. The UltraEdge rolls in and it confirms that the ball hit the pad first. The Ball Tracker indicates three reds and Mackay is a goner!

OUT! Another one bites the dust! England Women in command! A successful review helps them grab their eighth wicket. A fuller ball, around middle, spins a tad. Frances Mackay leans to defend this but the ball goes off the pad first and then the bat. An appeal for LBW but the umpire says no. England Women opt for a review! UltraEdge confirms it was pad first. The Ball Tracker shows three reds. The on-field decision has been overturned and Frances Mackay walks back!
Short of a length, outside off. Frances Mackay steers it to third man and takes a single.
Frances Mackay comes to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Devine holes out and this is a huge blow for New Zealand Women! Cross runs in and serves a slower ball, on a length, outside off. Devine sits back and looks to go over long on. Although, she hits is straight down the throat of Charlotte Dean at long on who takes a simple catch without moving an inch. Terrific passage of play for England Women!
Commentary.Howout: c Charlotte Dean b Kate Cross

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Streaky! Devine and New Zealand Women won't mind that at all! Good-length ball, around off. Devine throws her bat at it. It takes the thick outside edge and the ball goes over the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Fullish delivery, outside off. Maddy Green slaps it through cover and collects a single.
Back of a length, around off. Maddy Green defends it back to the bowler.
A length ball, angling in from middle. Maddy Green misses her flick and gets hit on her pad.
Flighted ball, on off. Sophie Devine drives it back to the bowler. A wicket-maiden from Sophie Ecclestone!
Full and around leg. Sophie Devine digs it out to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, around off. Sophie Devine keeps it out.

Heather Knight at extra cover, flies to her right and takes it cleanly. New Zealand Women are losing their way here!
Commentary.Howout: c Heather Knight b Sophie Ecclestone

Natalie Sciver there, dives to her right, collects the ball, and throws it to the keeper. Amy Jones collects the ball and whips the bails off. Full, around off. Brooke Halliday pushes it towards mid off.

Full, around off. Brooke Halliday drives it back to the bowler.

DRINKS! England Women have done reasonably well to pull things back in their favour and they would be happy with the way things have gone so far for them. New Zealand Women need a big partnership here as it is a good batting surface and they need to put up a competitive total on the board. Brooke Halliday walks out to bat.

OUT! LBW! England Women are picking up wickets just at the right time! Once again, Charlotte Dean gets the breakthrough. Another set batter goes back to the hut. Charlotte Dean tosses this one up, this one lands around middle and turns away just a tad. Amy Satterthwaite gets low and tries to sweep this away, but she misses and gets rapped on her front pad. The umpire's finger goes up immediately after an appeal for LBW. Amy Satterthwaite opts for a review! No bat involved confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracker shows it is the umpire's call on wickets hitting. So, the on-field decision stands. Charlotte Dean gets her second wicket and New Zealand Women lose their third.

Review! Amy Satterthwaite has opted for a review after being adjudged LBW! No bat involved, confirms the UltraEdge. The Ball Tracker rolls in and it shows that the ball would have clipped the bails. It is umpire's call on wickets hitting and so the on-field decision stands.

Edged but dropped! This is a good-length ball, around off. Maddy Green has a poke at it. The ball takes the outside edge and Amy Jones behind the sticks is a bit late to react. The ball hits her pad as she is standing up to the stumps.
On a length, on off. Amy Satterthwaite drives it to long on and takes a single.

An overthrow and they get a couple of runs. Good-length ball, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite pushes it to cover and sets off for a single. The fielder at cover hurls a wayward throw at the keeper's end and the batters take one more.

loopy ball, full, on middle. Maddy Green leans and blocks it out watchfully.

Anya Shrubsole out there, makes no mistake and grabs it safely. New Zealand Women lose their second wicket, just when a partnership was building!
Commentary.Howout: c Anya Shrubsole b Charlotte Dean

Loopy ball, full, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite looks to sweep this but she misses.

Good-length ball, on middle. Blocked out.

The White Ferns would be eager to steady things now and they need to make sure that they make full use of the good batting conditions. Amy Satterthwaite walks out to bat now.

Oh, dear! Sophie Devine looks in some pain and seems to be struggling with her back. The physio is out to have a check on her. Not a good sign for New Zealand Women as Devine is walking off the field with the physio.

Outside off this time, fuller ball. Amelia Kerr presses forward and blocks it out.
Fuller now, around middle. Amelia Kerr works it away to mid-wicket once again.
On a length, around middle. Amelia Kerr pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller ball, around middle. Amelia Kerr shows the full face of her bat and pushes it straight onto the stumps at the bowler's end.
On a length, outside off. Amelia Kerr leaves it alone.

Quick single! Fuller ball, around middle. Sophie Devine pushes it towards mid-wicket and scampers through to the other end. A little fumble by the fielder there allows the batter to complete the run comfortably.
Full again, outside off. Amelia Kerr defends it out.
Fuller now, outside off. Amelia Kerr leans and taps it towards point.
Length, angling in, on the pads. Sophie Devine flicks it past square leg for a single.
On a length, outside off. Sophie Devine lunges and defends it out.
Shorter ball now, around middle. Sophie Devine pulls it past mid-wicket for a brace.
Full, around middle. Sophie Devine works it away to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Angling in, on a fuller length, around middle. Sophie Devine tucks it towards square leg for a single. End of a successful over from Kate Cross!
Swing and a miss! On a length, outside off. Sophie Devine looks to cut this away but she misses.
Amelia Kerr walks in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! A much-needed breakthrough for England Women! Kate Cross strikes and gets rid of Suzie Bates. New Zealand Women lose their first wicket. On a length, outside off. Suzie Bates once again tries to go big, as she swings her bat to go over mid-wicket, but the ball goes off the outer half of the ball and flies towards mid off. Tammy Beaumont there, pouches it safely!
Commentary.Howout: c Tammy Beaumont b Kate Cross

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, shaping away, outside off. Suzie Bates looks to cut this away but she misses!
Suzie Bates decides to take the aerial route this time! Fuller ball, outside off. Suzie Bates advances down the pitch and lifts it over mid off. Two taken!
Good-length delivery, around middle. Sophie Devine tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Another fuller ball, around off. Suzie Bates drives it towards mid off.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Overpitched delivery, on middle. Suzie Bates presents the full face of her bat and drives it past mid on for a boundary!
Fuller ball, around middle. Suzie Bates drives it towards mid off.
Angling in around middle, on a good length. Suzie Bates walks down the pitch first, then stays back, and guides it towards third man for a brace.
Another length delivery, around middle and off. Suzie Bates pushes it towards cover.
On a length, angling in, on the pads. Suzie Bates looks to flick this, but she misses and gets rapped on her front pad.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, a maximum of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the circle till the 40th over!
On a length and just outside off. Sophie Devine gets forward and works it to mid off. No run there!
Full and well outside off. Sophie Devine prods and drives it towards the cover fielder yet again.
The square leg umpire walks up to Sophie Devine and warns her for landing on the danger area of the pitch while batting. Sophie Devine is batting way outside the crease.
Full and outside off. Sophie Devine drives it to the cover fielder.
Pitches it up, on middle. Sophie Devine pushes it to mid off.
Good-length ball, around off. Devine defends it to the off side.
FOUR! Nicely done! Back of a length, around the fifth stump. Sophie Devine cuts it past the diving fielder at cover and bags a boundary.
This is a length ball, well outside off. Sophie Devine steers it to third man for a single.
Short of a length, around off and cramping the batter for room. Devine looks to cut but she gets an underedge and onto the deck.
Shorter in length, outside off. Suzie Bates steers it past point and rotates the strike.
Good-length delivery, around off. Suzie Bates taps it to point.
Full and outside off. Sophie Devine looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single.
A length ball, around middle. Sophie Devine blocks it off the front foot.
Another bowling change. Natalie Sciver comes to bowl now.
Good-length delivery, nipping back in from middle. Suzie Bates tucks it towards mid-wicket.

Back of a length, outside off. Suzie Bates tries to cut but she fails to get any blade on it. The umpire is having a chat with Suzie Bates. It seems like Suzie Bates is standing outside the crease while batting and she is landing on the danger zone of the pitch while playing the ball.
Pitches it up, angling in late from off. Suzie Bates covers the line and pushes it towards mid on.
On a length, around off. Devine eases it to mid off and scampers through to the other end.
Good-length delivery, just outside off. Sophie Devine works it to the cover fielder.
Cross begins with a length ball, around off. Devine hangs back and pushes it to cover.
First bowling change! Kate Cross comes into the attack.
Another ball, full and outside off. Bates drives it back to the bowler.
Pitches it up, on off. Suzie Bates pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Pulled away! This is a shorter-length delivery, around off. Suzie Bates pulls it in front of square and bags a boundary.
On a length and angling in from middle. Suzie Bates drags it towards mid-wicket.
Shorter in length, outside off. Suzie Bates hangs on the back foot and punches it towards cover.
Back of a length, around off. Suzie Bates blocks it off the back foot.
Good-length ball, on middle. Sophie Devine defends it onto the deck.
Another ball, full and around leg. Sophie Devine nudges it behind square on the leg side for a brace.
FOUR! Picks it up beautifully! This is full and darted on the pads. Sophie Devine whips it off her pads through the fine leg region for a boundary.
Back of a length, around off. Sophie Devine hangs back and punches it towards cover.
Fuller in length, outside off. Suzie Bates drives it through the cover region and the batters take three runs.
A full ball, on middle. Suzie Bates pushes it towards mid on.
Another length delivery, shaping in, around middle. Sophie Devine gets an inside edge towards square leg. Good over from Katherine Brunt, 2 runs off it!
Shaping away now, on a length, outside off. Sophie Devine blocks it out.
Good-length delivery, angling in, around middle. Sophie Devine defends it out.
Yorker-length delivery, outside off. Sophie Devine squeezes it out towards point.
Shorter ball now, around middle and off. Sophie Devine stays in her crease and defends it out.
Pitches it up, outside off. Sophie Devine leans and drives it through cover for a brace.
On a length, swinging in, around middle. Suzie Bates defends it out.
On a length, nipping back in, around middle. Sophie Devine looks to block this, but the ball goes off the inside edge towards square leg.
FOUR! Classy! Full again, outside off. Sophie Devine leans and creams it past cover for a boundary.
Tad fuller again, outside off. Sophie Devine dabs it towards point.
Full again, swinging down leg. Suzie Bates clips it past square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, around off. Suzie Bates walks out and blocks it out towards mid off.
Much better from Katherine Brunt! Angling in, on a length, around middle and leg. Sophie Devine looks to block this but she gets beaten and gets hit on her pads as the ball nips back in.
Down the leg side again, on a good length. Sophie Devine misses her flick and she gets hit on her thigh pad.
Leg bye! On a length, angling in, down the leg side. Suzie Bates misses her glance and the ball goes off her thigh pads towards fine leg. The batters steal a leg bye!
Another shorter ball, around middle. Suzie Bates steps down the pitch and works it towards square leg.
FOUR! Top shot! Shorter ball, on middle. Suzie Bates rocks back and pulls it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of length, outside off. Sophie Devine dabs it towards third man for a single.
An inswinger again, tad fuller, around middle. Suzie Bates blocks it out.
Angling in, on middle, on a length. Suzie Bates defends it out.

Fuller, and wide of off. Sophie Devine leans and drives it towards past cover. Beaumont chases it, puts in a dive but fails to stop the ball cleanly. Sophia Dunkley who was also chasing the ball gets her fingertips on the ball and keeps the ball away from the boundary ropes! Three taken in the end!
TWO WIDES! Good-length delivery, down the leg side. Suzie Bates looks to tuck this away, but she misses. The keeper fails to grab the ball as well. One taken!
On a length, angling in, around middle. Suzie Bates defends it out.

TWO LEG BYES! On a length, swinging in, on the pads. Suzie Bates looks to flick this but the ball brushes off her pad and goes towards fine leg. Sophie Ecclestone chases it and keeps the ball away from the ropes. Two taken!
Fuller ball, angling in, around middle. Suzie Bates drives it towards mid off.
Wide! Anya Shrubsole begins with a wide as well! On a length, down the leg side. Suzie Bates misses her flick. Wide called!
Who will bowl from the other end? Anya Shrubsole it is.
FOUR! Cut away! Tad shorter, wide of off. Sophie Devine hangs back and chops it past point for a boundary. First boundary of the innings! 9 runs off the first over!
Swinging in, tad fuller, around middle and leg. Sophie Devine clips it past mid-wicket for a brace. Sophie Devine opens her account as well!
Good-length delivery, around middle. Sophie Devine defends it out.
Nipping back in, on a length, around middle. Suzie Bates tucks it towards mid-wicket and scampers through to the other end. She gets off the mark!
Tad fuller, on middle. Suzie Bates shows the full face of her bat and pushes it towards mid off.
Wide! Down the leg side, fuller length. Suzie Bates misses her tuck and wide is called!
Angling in, on a length, around middle. Suzie Bates once again looks to flick but she misses and gets hit on her pads.
Wide! Katherine Brunt begins with a full toss, down the leg side. Suzie Bates looks to flick this but she misses. Wide called! New Zealand Women are underway!

We are done with the anthems and the game is set to begin! The English players are in a huddle before they spread out on the field. Sophie Devine and Suzie Bates are at the crease for New Zealand Women. Katherine Brunt will start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
It is time for the national anthems! The match officials and the two sides have lined up for their respective national anthems. It will be England's first, followed by New Zealand's.

PITCH REPORT - Nasser Hussain and Ian Smith are near the pitch. Nasser says it's the same pitch that was used in the previous game and hence, the dimensions remain the same. Ian Smith says it's a true batting pitch. We can also expect the bowlers to get some extra bounce. No complaints about this wicket.

Sophie Devine, the skipper of New Zealand Women, says that they were looking to bat first anyway. Adds that they are unchanged going into this game. Mentions that they are very excited to play at Eden Park and says, it is outstanding to play at this venue.

Heather Knight, the skipper of England Women, says they are going to bowl first with a bit of weather around and they are looking forward to chase. Mentions that they are unchanged. States that it was good to get their first win and they want to carry the momentum.

New Zealand Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Suzie Bates, Sophie Devine (C), Amelia Kerr, Amy Satterthwaite, Maddy Green, Brooke Halliday, Katey Martin (WK), Frances Mackay, Hannah Rowe, Lea Tahuhu, Jess Kerr.

England Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Tammy Beaumont, Danni Wyatt, Heather Knight (C), Natalie Sciver, Amy Jones (WK), Sophia Dunkley, Katherine Brunt, Sophie Ecclestone, Kate Cross, Charlotte Dean, Anya Shrubsole.
TOSS - England Women have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

UPDATE - 3.00 am IST (9.30 pm GMT, previous night) - There was some rain just minutes before the toss and hence, the toss has been delayed. The toss is scheduled at 3.10 am IST (9.40 pm GMT, previous night). The good thing is that there is no rain at the moment, so we hope that the game begins on time.

Just like their opponents, New Zealand Women also are not having the best time in the tournament. They have managed to win just two games out of the five games they have played. They are coming into this game at the back of a defeat against South Africa Women. But the hosts will need to turn things around before it gets too late for them. Things are only getting tougher for the teams to qualify for the semi-final. Who will come out on top in this must-win encounter? We will find out. Stay tuned for the toss and team news.

After losing three games on the trot, England Women fought back well and have finally managed to win a game in this competition. The defending champions, England Women have not been at their best, but we did see what they are truly capable of in their previous clash. They will have to win their remaining games to try and seal a spot in the semi-final.

Hello and a warm welcome folks! It’s time for match number 19 of this exuberant tournament. We will witness a clash between New Zealand Women and England Women. Both sides will be eager to put their best foot forward in order to keep themselves in contention for the semi-final. There is rain predicted for today’s game, but let’s hope the weather remains kind and there are no interruptions in this exciting contest.
